entries.name: EnterWorktree
entries.description:
Use this tool ONLY when explicitly instructed to work in a worktree — either by the user directly, or by project instructions (CLAUDE.md / memory). This tool creates an isolated git worktree and switches the current session into it.

## When to Use

- The user explicitly says "worktree" (e.g., "start a worktree", "work in a worktree", "create a worktree", "use a worktree")
- CLAUDE.md or memory instructions direct you to work in a worktree for the current task

## When NOT to Use

- The user asks to create a branch, switch branches, or work on a different branch — use git commands instead
- The user asks to fix a bug or work on a feature — use normal git workflow unless worktrees are explicitly requested by the user or project instructions
- Never use this tool unless "worktree" is explicitly mentioned by the user or in CLAUDE.md / memory instructions

## Requirements

- Must be in a git repository, OR have WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks configured in settings.json
- Must not already be in a worktree session when creating a new worktree (`name`); switching into another existing worktree via `path` is allowed

## Behavior

- In a git repository: creates a new git worktree inside `.claude/worktrees/` on a new branch. The base ref is governed by the `worktree.baseRef` setting: `fresh` (default) branches from origin/<default-branch>; `head` branches from your current local HEAD
- Outside a git repository: delegates to WorktreeCreate/WorktreeRemove hooks for VCS-agnostic isolation
- Switches the session's working directory to the new worktree
- Use ExitWorktree to leave the worktree mid-session (keep or remove). On session exit, if still in the worktree, the user will be prompted to keep or remove it

## Entering an existing worktree

Pass `path` instead of `name` to switch the session into a worktree that already exists (e.g., one you just created with `git worktree add`). On first entry from the launch directory, the path must appear in `git worktree list` for the repository that owns it — the current repository or, in a multi-repo workspace, a repository nested inside it; paths registered by neither are rejected. ExitWorktree will not remove a worktree entered this way; use `action: "keep"` to return to the original directory.

Switching with `path` also works when the session is already in a worktree (the previous worktree is left on disk, untouched, and only the new one is tracked for exit-time cleanup), and from agents whose working directory was pinned at launch (subagent isolation or explicit cwd). In both cases the target must be a worktree under `.claude/worktrees/` of the same repository, and from a pinned agent the switch only affects this agent, not the parent session. After a further switch, previously-visited worktrees are no longer writable — re-issue EnterWorktree with `path` to return to one.

## Parameters

- `name` (optional): A name for a new worktree. If neither `name` nor `path` is provided, a random name is generated.
- `path` (optional): Path to an existing worktree to enter instead of creating one — of the current repository, or (on first entry from the launch directory) of a repository nested inside it. Mutually exclusive with `name`.

name.description: Optional name for a new worktree. Each "/"-separated segment may contain only letters, digits, dots, underscores, and dashes; max 64 chars total. A random name is generated if not provided. Mutually exclusive with `path`.

path.description: Path to an existing worktree to switch into instead of creating a new one. Must appear in `git worktree list` for the current repo — or, on first entry from the launch directory, for a repo nested inside it (multi-repo workspace). Mutually exclusive with `name`.

entries.name: Monitor
entries.description:
Start a background monitor that streams events from a long-running script. Each stdout line is an event — you keep working and notifications arrive in the chat. Events arrive on their own schedule and are not replies from the user, even if one lands while you're waiting for the user to answer a question.

Pick by how many notifications you need:
- **One** ("tell me when the server is ready / the build finishes") → use **Bash with `run_in_background`** and a command that exits when the condition is true, e.g. `until grep -q "Ready in" dev.log; do sleep 0.5; done`. You get a single completion notification when it exits.
- **One per occurrence, until the monitor expires (re-arm to continue)** ("tell me every time an ERROR line appears") → Monitor with an unbounded command (`tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, `while true`).
- **One per occurrence, until a known end** ("emit each CI step result, stop when the run completes") → Monitor with a command that emits lines and then exits.

Your script's stdout is the event stream. Each line becomes a notification. Exit ends the watch.

  # Each matching log line is an event
  tail -f /var/log/app.log | grep --line-buffered "ERROR"

  # Each file change is an event
  inotifywait -m --format '%e %f' /watched/dir

  # Poll GitHub for new PR comments and emit one line per new comment
  last=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
  while true; do
    now=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ)
    gh api "repos/owner/repo/issues/123/comments?since=$last" --jq '.[] | "\(.user.login): \(.body)"'
    last=$now; sleep 30
  done

  # Node script that emits events as they arrive (e.g. WebSocket listener)
  node watch-for-events.js

  # Per-occurrence with a natural end: emit each CI check as it lands, exit when the run completes
  prev=""
  while true; do
    s=$(gh pr checks 123 --json name,bucket)
    cur=$(jq -r '.[] | select(.bucket!="pending") | "\(.name): \(.bucket)"' <<<"$s" | sort)
    comm -13 <(echo "$prev") <(echo "$cur")
    prev=$cur
    jq -e 'all(.bucket!="pending")' <<<"$s" >/dev/null && break
    sleep 30
  done

**Don't use an unbounded command for a single notification.** `tail -f`, `inotifywait -m`, and `while true` never exit on their own, so the monitor stays armed until timeout even after the event has fired. For "tell me when X is ready," use Bash `run_in_background` with an `until` loop instead (one notification, ends in seconds). Note that `tail -f log | grep -m 1 ...` does *not* fix this: if the log goes quiet after the match, `tail` never receives SIGPIPE and the pipeline hangs anyway.

**Script quality:**
- Every pipe stage must flush per line or matches sit in its buffer unseen: `grep` needs `--line-buffered`, `awk` needs `fflush()`. `head` cannot flush at all — `| head -N` delivers nothing until N matches accumulate, then ends the stream.
- In poll loops, handle transient failures (`curl ... || true`) — one failed request shouldn't kill the monitor.
- Poll intervals: 30s+ for remote APIs (rate limits), 0.5-1s for local checks.
- Write a specific `description` — it appears in every notification ("errors in deploy.log" not "watching logs").
- Only stdout is the event stream. Stderr goes to the output file (readable via Read) but does not trigger notifications — for a command you run directly (e.g. `python train.py 2>&1 | grep --line-buffered ...`), merge stderr with `2>&1` so its failures reach your filter. (No effect on `tail -f` of an existing log — that file only contains what its writer redirected.)

**Coverage — silence is not success.** When watching a job or process for an outcome, your filter must match every terminal state, not just the happy path. A monitor that greps only for the success marker stays silent through a crashloop, a hung process, or an unexpected exit — and silence looks identical to "still running." Before arming, ask: *if this process crashed right now, would my filter emit anything?* If not, widen it.

  # Wrong — silent on crash, hang, or any non-success exit
  tail -f run.log | grep --line-buffered "elapsed_steps="

  # Right — one alternation covering progress + the failure signatures you'd act on
  tail -f run.log | grep -E --line-buffered "elapsed_steps=|Traceback|Error|FAILED|assert|Killed|OOM"

For poll loops checking job state, emit on every terminal status (`succeeded|failed|cancelled|timeout`), not just success. If you cannot confidently enumerate the failure signatures, broaden the grep alternation rather than narrow it — some extra noise is better than missing a crashloop.

**Output volume**: Every stdout line is a conversation message, so the filter should be selective — but selective means "the lines you'd act on," not "only good news." Never pipe raw logs; filter to exactly the success and failure signals you care about. Monitors that produce too many events are automatically stopped; restart with a tighter filter if this happens.

Stdout lines within 200ms are batched into a single notification, so multiline output from a single event groups naturally.

The script runs in the same shell environment as Bash. Exit ends the watch (exit code is reported). Every monitor expires after `timeout_ms` (default 5 minutes, at most 10 minutes): it is killed and you get one notice with the event count. Re-arm it if you still need the watch; for a long watch (PR monitoring, log tails) set `timeout_ms` to the maximum and re-arm on each expiry, and widen the filter if an expiry with no events was unexpected. Use TaskStop to cancel early.
**ws source** — open a WebSocket and stream each incoming text frame as an event. No shell, no polling: the server pushes, you get notified.

  Monitor({
    ws: {url: 'wss://events.example.com/stream', protocols: ['v1']},
    description: 'deploy events',
  })

Each text frame becomes one notification (multiline frames stay as one event). Binary frames are reported as `[binary frame, N bytes]` rather than passed through. Socket close ends the watch with the close code surfaced; errors are surfaced before close. Same rate limiting as bash — a firehose will be suppressed and eventually stopped, so subscribe to a filtered feed where one exists.

Prefer this over `command: 'websocat wss://…'` — it avoids the extra process and line-buffering pitfalls. Use bash when you need to transform or filter frames with shell tools before they become events.

description.description: Short human-readable description of what you are monitoring (shown in notifications).

timeout_ms.description: Kill the monitor after this deadline. Default 300000ms. Deadlines above 600000ms are capped to 600000ms. You are notified at expiry and can re-arm.

command.description: Shell command or script. Each stdout line is an event; exit ends the watch.

ws.description: WebSocket to open. Each text frame is an event; binary frames are reported as a placeholder line. Socket close ends the watch. Cannot be combined with command.

entries.name: WebFetch
entries.description:
Fetches a URL, converts the page to markdown, and answers `prompt` against it using a small fast model.

- Fails on authenticated/private URLs — use an authenticated MCP tool or `gh` for those instead.
- Fails on localhost and other hostnames without a dot; for a local server, use curl via Bash.
- HTTP is upgraded to HTTPS. Cross-host redirects are returned to you rather than followed; call again with the redirect URL.
- Responses are cached for 15 minutes per URL.

prompt.description: The prompt to run on the fetched content

offset.description: Character position in the page text to start reading from. Use it to read on through a page too long for one call, with the value the previous result gave.

# u4-l1 · cuda_graph.rs：图捕获、指针稳定性与 padding 页

## 1. 本讲目标
- 3-4 bullets mapping to 学习目标.

## 2. 前置知识
- CUDA Graph 是什么：一次 decode step = 上百次 kernel launch，每次 launch 有 ~几 µs 的 CPU 开销；CUDA Graph 把一串 launch 录成一张 DAG（捕获），之后一条 cuGraphLaunch 整体重放，CPU 开销摊薄为一次。
- 关键术语：捕获、实例化（instantiate）、上传、重放；CUgraph vs CUgraphExec。
- 指针稳定性：图把 kernel 的参数（包括指针）固化进 exec；重放不会重新读 Rust 侧变量。
- 承接 u2-l3（ops 门面、graphsafe 命名）、u3-l2（KvPool/KvState/KvDesc、两段式准入）、u1-l1（分层：core 提供机制，模型 crate 执行）。
- 交代证据边界：本讲的模型 crate 侧事实来自 CLAUDE.md，core 内事实全部来自源码。

## 3. 本讲源码地图
表格: 文件 | 行数 | 作用
- src/cuda_graph.rs 234 状态机
- src/cuda_graph/dump.rs 569 检视工具（driver API + dot + c++filt）
- src/cuda_graph/dump/render.rs 604 human 视图（折叠重复 DAG）
- src/kv_pool.rs 563 padding 页 + 两段式准入（本讲只取相关切片）
- src/ops.rs 115 graphsafe GEMM 再出口
- src/ops/paged_plan.rs L156 graph-stable 复用
- lib.rs L4 模块挂载
- CLAUDE.md 机制归属事实

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 CudaGraphState：一次捕获、多次重放的状态机
4.1.1 概念说明 — decode 为什么需要图；CUgraph/CUgraphExec 句柄；与 active_cu_stream 绑定（Green Context）。
4.1.2 核心流程 — 首次调用 run_or_capture*：BeginCapture(THREAD_LOCAL) → 跑 kernels 闭包 → EndCapture → InstantiateWithFlags(AUTO_FREE_ON_LAUNCH) → 首次 launch；此后每次：cuGraphLaunch 直接重放。错误中止路径。伪代码。
4.1.3 源码精读 — 引用：
- struct + ctx_anchor（L42-L52）说明为何要锚住 context
- run_or_capture 契约 doc L98 + L99
- capture_and_instantiate L161：BeginCapture L175、中止 L184、EndCapture L194、Instantiate L200-L206、anchor L210
- launch_captured L84（cuGraphLaunch L91）

- run_or_capture_synchronized L128 + CudaGraphPhase L20-L28（这个回调正好是 dump/诊断挂点? 注意：phase 回调用途——synchronize 回调在 capture 前后/launch 前后插钩子，供调用方做流同步或观测）
- Drop L223、Send L57
4.1.4 代码实践 — 源码阅读型：给 run_or_capture_synchronized 画时序/写伪代码；标注六个 phase 各发生在哪一行。待本地验证（不需要 GPU）。
4.1.5 小练习与答案 — 3 题： 为什么 exec 非空即已捕获；capture 期间 kernel 闭包出错为什么要 EndCapture(aborted)；ctx_anchor 为什么存在（Drop 顺序）。

### 4.2 指针稳定性：为什么捕获期间禁止分配与同步
4.2.1 概念 — 图固化的三类东西：kernel 参数值（指针/标量）、依赖边、grid/block。重放 = 原样重发。若地址变 → 图仍写旧地址 → 错数据/越界。 → 与预分配 buffer 的因果（CLAUDE.md fact）；core 内的三个配套：graphsafe GEMM、paged plan 图稳定复用、padding 页。
4.2.2 核心流程 — decode step 的输入如何"换内容不换地址"：输入 token/位置写进预分配 buffer；KV 追加写入已预留页；batch 维度固定为满槽 + padding 行补齐；注意力计划表原地重填。
4.2.3 源码精读 —
- L98 契约（再引）
- ops.rs L49-L50 graphsafe（命名即约束：普通 gemm_into 每次可临时分配 workspace，graphsafe 版保证图内安全——语义细节在 kernels，标注待确认范围）
- paged_plan.rs L156 graph-stable buffer reuse
- cuda_graph.rs L33-L41 active_cu_stream/Green Context doc（捕获绑定执行上下文——另一种"固化"）
4.2.4 代码实践 — 反例推演（对应综合实践问题 1 的预演）：写出"KV 页地址每步变化"时重放坏在哪。给一个表格练习：列出 decode step 中每类输入、谁是地址、谁是内容。待本地验证。
4.2.5 小练习 — 2-3 题。

### 4.3 padding 页：池构造期的确定性预留
4.3.1 概念 — 图回放时 batch 是固定满槽；空槽=padding 行，其 KV 元数据必须指向一个"永远有效、内容无关紧要"的页；该页不能被任何请求租走 → 构造期永久租约。padding 行是协议面（连到 CLAUDE.md EP 纪律）。
4.3.2 核心流程 — KvPool 构造：算几何 → 分配整块 buffer → PagePool::new → try_acquire_many(1) 永久持有 → padding_page_id() 暴露。请求侧两段式准入与此并列：try_reserve（schedule 半段）/ commit_reservation（apply 半段），失败靠 Drop 回滚——保证 padding 页永远不会被误发。
4.3.3 源码精读 —
- L121-L124 字段 + doc（FlashInfer seq_len=1、写无害垃圾、输出被丢弃）
- L221-L236 构造尾部（buffer L221、PagePool L226、padding L227-L229、init L236）
- L269-L271 padding_page_id
- L278 try_reserve + doc（atomic multi-pool admission）；L382 commit_reservation
- L390 desc / L397 desc_for_len / L427 KvDesc（kernel 看到的页表）
4.3.4 代码实践 — 手算 + 反证：为什么运行期再申请 padding 页会破坏图（若页 id 变化 → 已固化的元数据行指向别人的页）；对照 kv_state_out_of_pages 测试（L541）确认页预算会计。待本地验证。
4.3.5 小练习。

### 4.4 dump 工具：把已捕获的图变成可读的 DOT/PNG
4.4.1 概念 — 诊断需求：图是黑盒（一串固化 launch）；dump 用 driver API 反查节点/边，经 c++filt demangle，产出 detailed.dot（全量）与 human 视图（折叠重复层），再由 Graphviz dot 渲染 PNG。
4.4.2 核心流程 — validate（扩展名 png、建目录、驱动 ≥12.3、dot/c++filt 在场）→ dump_png（inspect → 写 detailed dot → render_png(human_dot) → 返回 summary 计数）。inspect：GetNodes/GetEdges_v2 → 每节点 GetType→KernelNodeGetParams→cuFuncGetName；demangle 子进程 + communicate 双向排水。
4.4.3 源码精读 —
- L24-L31 CudaGraphDumpSummary（能暴露什么：nodes/edges/kernels 计数 + 两个文件路径）
- L76-L99 validate（含 L97 c++filt 检查、L102/L106 12.3 门槛）

4.4.5 小练习。

## 5. 综合实践 — 按规格：三问结构化笔记 + 交汇点行号：
(1) KV 页地址每步变 → 图坏在哪行语义：重放时 kernel 参数中的 KV 指针/页表内容已固化——具体到本仓库：注意力 kernel 读的页表 i32 行在捕获时指向页 A；重放不重读 Rust 侧 Vec → 仍按旧页表读 → 读到别人的 KV 或已回收页。给出引用：L91 cuGraphLaunch 重放不重新求值参数；paged_plan L156 graph-stable 复用正是对策。
(2) padding 页为何构造期预留：运行期申请的页 id 不确定 → 已固化的 padding 元数据行指向的页可能被换租/内容被请求写入 → padding 行不再无害（对照 L121-124 doc 的三条承诺：seq_len=1 指向、无害垃圾、输出丢弃，全部依赖"该页永久不被租出"）；且构造期 try_acquire_many(1) 保证 id 恒为首次发放的最小页号（page_pool rev() 纪律，u3-l1），重放确定性。

## 2. 前置知识
- CUDA Graph 是什么：一次 decode step = 上百次 kernel launch，每次 launch 有 ~几 µs 的 CPU 开销；CUDA Graph 把一串 launch 录成一张 DAG（捕获），之后一条 cuGraphLaunch 整体重放，CPU 开销摊薄为一次。
- 关键术语：捕获、实例化（instantiate）、上传、重放；CUgraph vs CUgraphExec。
- 指针稳定性：图把 kernel 的参数（包括指针）固化进 exec；重放不会重新读 Rust 侧变量。
- 承接 u2-l3（ops 门面、graphsafe 命名）、u3-l2（KvPool/KvState/KvDesc、两段式准入）、u1-l1（分层：core 提供机制，模型 crate 执行）。

## 1. 本讲目标

学完本讲，你应该能够：

1. **解释 CUDA Graph 重放对指针稳定性的要求**，以及它为什么与「decode 路径用预分配 buffer」构成因果关系。
2. **把三件事串成一个内存纪律故事**：padding 页（kv_pool 构造期永久预留）、两段式 admission（try_reserve / commit）、图捕获期间禁止分配与同步。
3. **读懂 `CudaGraphState` 的完整生命周期**：捕获（BeginCapture）→ 实例化（InstantiateWithFlags）→ 上传（可选 cuGraphUpload）→ 重放。
4. **了解 `dump` 子模块在诊断已捕获图结构时的用途与边界**：它能暴露什么、不能暴露什么。

本讲全部源码事实来自 `pegainfer-core`（行号经逐条核对）；涉及模型 crate（如 pegainfer-qwen3）的事实来自 CLAUDE.md，具体文件路径标注「待确认」——本讲义的读取权限仅覆盖 pegainfer-core。

## 2. 前置知识

### 2.1 为什么需要 CUDA Graph

一次 decode 步骤要发射上百个 kernel。每个 `cuLaunchKernel` 都有微秒级的 CPU 侧开销，步骤时间大致是：

\[ t_{\text{step}} \approx n \cdot t_{\text{launch}} + t_{\text{GPU}} \]

其中 \( n \) 是 kernel 数、\( t_{\text{launch}} \) 是单次发射的 CPU 开销。CUDA Graph 把这一串发射**录制成一张 DAG**（捕获，capture），之后每步用**一次** `cuGraphLaunch` 整体重放（replay）：

\[ t_{\text{step}} \approx 1 \cdot t_{\text{launch}} + t_{\text{GPU}} \]

术语速查：

| 术语 | 含义 |
|------|------|
| 捕获 | 在一条流上调用 `cuStreamBeginCapture`，随后正常发射 kernel，驱动把发射记录成图而非立即执行，最后 `cuStreamEndCapture` 取回 `CUgraph` |
| 实例化 | `cuGraphInstantiateWithFlags` 把 `CUgraph` 编译成可启动的 `CUgraphExec` |
| 上传 | `cuGraphUpload` 把 exec 预先搬到设备，让后续 launch 变成纯入队操作 |
| 重放 | `cuGraphLaunch(exec, stream)` 原样重发整张图 |
| 指针稳定性 | 图把 kernel 的**参数值**（含指针、标量）固化进 exec；重放时**不会**重新读取 Rust 侧变量 |
| Green Context | CUDA 的 SM 分区机制；本讲只涉及「捕获绑定的执行上下文」这一点 |

## 4. 核心概念与源码讲解

### 4.1 CudaGraphState：一次捕获、多次重放的状态机

#### 4.1.1 概念说明

`CudaGraphState` 是 decode 路径的图状态容器：第一次 decode 调用时把整串 kernel 捕获成图，之后每步只重放。它解决的问题是「kernel 发射的 CPU 开销随批量不变、随层数线性增长」。

两个容易混淆的句柄要分清：

- `CUgraph`：捕获产物，图的拓扑描述（本文件第 5 行导入）。
- `CUgraphExec`：实例化产物，真正可被 `cuGraphLaunch` 启动的可执行体（第 6 行导入）。**`exec` 非空 ≈ 已经捕获过**，这是 `is_captured()` 的判据。

#### 4.1.2 核心流程

`run_or_capture_synchronized`（首次调用走捕获分支，之后走重放分支）：

```text
若 exec 非空（已捕获）：
    synchronize(BeforeLaunch)
    cuGraphLaunch(exec, active_cu_stream(ctx))     ← 纯重放
    synchronize(AfterLaunch)
    返回

否则（首次）：
    cuStreamBeginCapture_v2(stream, THREAD_LOCAL)  ← 开始捕获
    运行 kernels 闭包                                ← kernel 不执行，只被记录
        若闭包出错：
            cuStreamEndCapture(stream, &aborted)    ← 必须结束捕获，否则流卡死
            cuGraphDestroy(aborted)                 ← 丢弃残图
            向上传播原错误
    cuStreamEndCapture(stream, &graph)              ← 取回 CUgraph
    cuGraphInstantiateWithFlags(&exec, graph, AUTO_FREE_ON_LAUNCH)
    ctx_anchor = Some(ctx.ctx.clone())              ← 锚住 context 生命周期
    cuGraphLaunch(exec, stream)                     ← 首次 launch
```

六个阶段点由 `CudaGraphPhase` 枚举暴露给调用方的回调，便于在捕获/重放前后插入同步或观测钩子。

### 4.2 指针稳定性：为什么捕获期间禁止分配与同步

#### 4.2.1 概念说明

图固化的不只是拓扑，还有**每个节点的参数值**：数据指针、标量（如 seq_len）、grid/block 维度。重放是把录制好的参数原样重发，**不会**回到 Rust 侧重新求值。因此：

- 若某步换了一块新分配的 buffer（地址变了），重放仍读写**旧地址**——不是崩溃，而是静默的错数据，比崩溃更难查。
- 若捕获期间做 CPU-GPU 同步（如读回结果），捕获本身会失败或产生非法图。
- 若捕获期间分配新显存，分配动作不会被录进图（它是 runtime 调用不是 kernel），重放时这个 buffer 可能已被释放。

由此得到 CLAUDE.md 记载的既定设计（[CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/CLAUDE.md)，Key abstractions 一节）：**decode 路径在模型 executor 内捕获 CUDA Graph，用预分配 buffer 保持指针稳定**。core 为这条纪律提供三件配套，这正是「图捕获/回放入口」与 KV 状态在 core 内的真正交汇方式（函数级没有调用关系，是纪律级的配合）。

#### 4.2.2 核心流程

一个 graph-safe 的 decode 步骤要做到「换内容不换地址」：

```text
每步开始
  ├─ 新 token / 位置 → 写进预分配的输入 buffer（地址不变，只改内容）
  ├─ KV 追加 → 写进该请求已预留的页（页表不因本步而变）
  ├─ batch 不足满槽 → padding 行补齐（指向永久预留页，见 4.3）
  ├─ 注意力计划表（i32 页表行）→ 原地重填同一块 buffer
  └─ cuGraphLaunch：整图重放，读到的全是上面这些地址里的新内容
```

#### 4.2.3 源码精读

**契约文本。** [cuda_graph.rs:L98](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph.rs#L98) 的 `no CPU-GPU sync, no allocation`（见 4.1.3 引文）——这句话把「重放安全」的责任压给了调用方传入的闭包。

### 4.3 padding 页：池构造期的确定性预留

#### 4.3.1 概念说明

图回放时 batch 是**固定满槽**的：捕获时按 N 个槽发射 kernel，重放永远按 N 个槽执行。实际请求不足 N 时，空槽就是 **padding 行**。padding 行的 KV 元数据必须指向一个「永远有效、内容无关紧要」的页——这个页不能被任何请求租走，所以它在 **KvPool 构造期就被永久租下**。

这呼应 CLAUDE.md 的 EP free-running 纪律：「Padding rows are protocol surface（padding 行是协议面）——每个 dummy 行的输入必须是构造性确定的」。单卡 KV 池里的 padding 页，就是这条多卡纪律的单卡缩影。

#### 4.3.2 核心流程

```text
KvPool::with_storage_and_format
  ├─ KvLayout 几何计算（u3-l2 讲过）
  ├─ 整块 alloc_zeros 分配 KV buffer（一次性）
  ├─ PagePool::new(num_pages)              ← 页分配器
  ├─ try_acquire_many(1) 永久租 1 页        ← padding 页，永不归还
  └─ 存入 KvPoolInner.padding_permit       ← RAII 持有到池销毁

请求侧（与 padding 页并列的另一条纪律线）：
  try_reserve(pages)      ← schedule 半段：全池先预订，失败靠 Drop 回滚
  commit_reservation()    ← apply 半段：全部预订成功才吸收进 KvState
```

#### 4.3.3 源码精读

**字段与三条承诺。** [kv_pool.rs:L121-L124](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L121-L124)：

```rust
/// Reserved page for bucket CUDA Graph padding. FlashInfer metadata for
/// padding slots points here with seq_len=1. KV append writes harmless
/// garbage; attention output is discarded.
padding_permit: OwnedPagePermit,
```

三条承诺：padding 槽的元数据以 `seq_len=1` 指向本页；KV 追加往里写的是无害垃圾；注意力的输出被丢弃。三条全部依赖「此页永远不被租给请求」。

**构造期预留。** [kv_pool.rs:L221-L236](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L221-L236)：整块 buffer 分配（第 221 行）→ `PagePool::new`（第 226 行）→ `pool.try_acquire_many(1)`（第 227 行）→ `.expect("pool must have at least 1 page for padding")`（第 229 行）→ 存入结构（第 236 行）。注意这是**新建的空池上的第一次获取**，结合 u3-l1 讲过的「页升序发放」，padding 页 id 是确定的最小页号。

**对外暴露。** [kv_pool.rs:L269-L271](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L269-L271)：

```rust
/// Page index reserved for bucket CUDA Graph padding.
pub fn padding_page_id(&self) -> i32 {
    self.inner.padding_permit.pages()[0].index() as i32
}
```

在 core 内 `grep -rn 'padding' src/ops` 无匹配：`padding_page_id` 的消费方在模型 crate（把 padding 槽的页表行填成这个 id），具体调用文件**待确认**（u4-l3 从消费面核验）。

**两段式准入（对照线）。** [kv_pool.rs:L278](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L278) `try_reserve` 的文档自称「atomic multi-pool admission 的 schedule 半段」：先从所有池预订、全部成功才提交、失败靠 Drop 回滚；[第 382 行](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L382) `commit_reservation` 是 apply 半段（`permit.absorb`，u3-l1 讲过 absorb 会断言同池）。padding 页在这个协议之外——它从不进入 free-list，`try_reserve` 永远看不到它。

**kernel 看到什么。** [kv_pool.rs:L390](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L390) `desc()` 与 [第 397 行](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L397) `desc_for_len()`（强校验页数恰等于所需）产出 [第 427 行](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L427) 的 `KvDesc`（pages + last_page_len）。内核消费的页表行里，padding 槽填的就是 `padding_page_id()`。

#### 4.3.5 小练习与答案

**练习 1**：padding 页为什么不能也走 `try_reserve`，在第一次需要 padding 时再租？
**答案**：三连失败：运行期租页违反捕获期禁止分配的契约（[cuda_graph.rs:L98](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph.rs#L98)）；租到的页 id 不确定，已固化的 padding 元数据行可能指向错误页；租来的页可能被请求数据写入，[第 121-124 行](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L121-L124) 的三条承诺全部作废。

**练习 2**：`padding_page_id()` 返回 `i32` 而不是 `PageId`，说明什么？
**答案**：它面向的是「填进 i32 页表行、给 kernel 消费」的场景（与 [第 334 行](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L334) `page_indices_i32` 同一格式）；`PageId` 的不透明性只在 core 内部维持（u3-l1 讲过转整数仅限 crate 内部，这里是公开出口）。

**练习 3**：如果两个 KvPool 共享一个 PagePool，padding 机制会怎样？
**答案**：当前设计里每个 `KvPool` 构造时 `PagePool::new(num_pages)` **独占**新建分配器（[第 226 行](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L226)），不存在共享场景；多池准入（`try_reserve` 文档的 multi-pool admission）指的是多个**各自持有池**的调度协同。

### 4.4 dump 工具：把已捕获的图变成可读的 DOT/PNG

#### 4.4.1 概念说明

图一旦捕获就是黑盒：一串固化的发射，肉眼无法核对「这一步到底录了哪些 kernel、依赖边对不对」。`dump` 子模块用 driver API **反查**已捕获图的节点与边，经 `c++filt` demangle 内核名，产出两个视图：

- **detailed 视图**：全量 DOT 文件，每节点保留原始符号、grid/block、共享内存，每条边保留端口与依赖类型。
- **human 视图**（render.rs）：把 decode 图里成百上千个重复的层结构**折叠**成摘要节点，再由 Graphviz 渲染 PNG。

这是「图结构诊断」工具，不是性能分析器（见练习 3 的边界）。

#### 4.4.2 核心流程

```text
validate_graph_dump_request（启动期校验，一次性）
  ├─ 扩展名必须是 .png（大小写不敏感）
  ├─ 创建输出父目录
  ├─ 驱动 API 版本 ≥ 12.3（内核名查询的门槛）
  └─ 外部工具 dot（-Tpng:cairo）与 c++filt 在场

dump_png（事后诊断）
  ├─ ensure 已捕获
  ├─ inspect：
  │    ├─ cuGraphGetNodes（两段式：先计数后取句柄）
  │    ├─ 每节点 cuGraphNodeGetType → 非内核记类型字符串
  │    │        内核 → cuGraphKernelNodeGetParams_v2 → cuFuncGetName
  │    ├─ 收集全部内核符号 → c++filt 子进程批量 demangle
  │    └─ cuGraphGetEdges_v2 → 句柄映射为下标 + 端口/依赖类型
  ├─ 写 detailed.dot 文件
  ├─ render_png：dot -Tpng:cairo -Gdpi=192 渲染 human 视图
  └─ 返回 CudaGraphDumpSummary（计数 + 两个文件路径）
```

#### 4.4.3 源码精读

**对外类型。** [dump.rs:L24-L30](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump.rs#L24-L30) `CudaGraphDumpSummary`：`nodes` / `edges` / `kernels` 三个计数 + `dot_path` / `png_path` 两个路径——这就是「dump 能告诉你什么」的完整答案。core 通过 [cuda_graph.rs:L17-L18](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph.rs#L17-L18) 把它与 `validate_graph_dump_request` 再出口给模型 crate。

**前置校验。** [dump.rs:L76](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump.rs#L76) 起 `validate_graph_dump_request`：png 扩展名检查、建目录、[第 97 行](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump.rs#L97) 起检查 `c++filt` 在场；驱动版本门槛在 [第 101-110 行](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump.rs#L101-L110)：`MIN_DRIVER_API_VERSION = 12_030`（第 102 行），经 `cuDriverGetVersion`（第 106 行）比对——内核名查询（`cuFuncGetName`）需要 CUDA 12.3+。

## 5. 综合实践

写一篇结构化笔记，回答三个问题并完成一次交汇点定位（全部为源码阅读型，无需 GPU；结论处给出的行号均已核对）：

**问题 1：如果 decode 步骤的 KV 页地址每步都变，图回放会坏在哪一行语义上？**

答题要点（参考答案）：坏的不是某一行 Rust 代码，而是重放的**参数固化语义**——[cuda_graph.rs:L91](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph.rs#L91) 的 `cuGraphLaunch` 把捕获时刻的 kernel 参数（KV buffer 指针、页表行内容、seq_len 标量）原样重发。若每步重新分配 KV 页：注意力 kernel 仍按捕获时刻的页表读——读到**别的请求**的 KV 或已回收的页；KV 追加 kernel 写进旧地址——静默污染。Rust 侧每步重建的 `Vec` 图根本不会重读。对策正是 4.2 的三件套：预分配 buffer（CLAUDE.md 事实）、graph-stable 计划表原地重填（[ops/paged_plan.rs:L156](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/ops/paged_plan.rs#L156)）、graphsafe 算子（[ops.rs:L49-L50](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/ops.rs#L49-L50)）。

**问题 2：padding 页为什么必须在池构造期就预留，而不是运行期再申请？**

答题要点（参考答案）：三层原因。① 契约层：捕获期禁止分配（[cuda_graph.rs:L98](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph.rs#L98)），运行期申请本身可能发生在捕获中；② 确定性层：构造期在**全新空池**上 `try_acquire_many(1)`（[kv_pool.rs:L227](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L227)），页 id 确定且永不变化；运行期租页的 id 取决于当时的 free-list 状态，而图中固化的 padding 元数据行不会跟着变；③ 语义层：[kv_pool.rs:L121-L124](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L121-L124) 的三条承诺（seq_len=1 指向、无害垃圾、输出丢弃）依赖该页**永远不被租给请求**——只有构造期的永久 `OwnedPagePermit`（RAII 持有到池销毁，[第 236 行](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L236)）能保证，`try_reserve` 的请求路径永远看不到它。

**问题 3：dump.rs 能暴露图的哪些信息（以原文为准）？**

答题要点（参考答案）：见 4.4.3——`CudaGraphDumpSummary` 的 nodes/edges/kernels 计数与 dot/png 路径（[dump.rs:L24-L30](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump.rs#L24-L30)）；detailed DOT 的逐节点原始/解构符号、grid/block、动态共享内存与逐边端口/依赖类型（[L299](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump.rs#L299)、[L546](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump.rs#L546)）；human PNG 的重复子图折叠与紧凑内核名（[render.rs:L55](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump/render.rs#L55)、[L409](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump/render.rs#L409)）。**不能**暴露耗时与显存流量（源码无此路径）。

## 6. 本讲小结

- `CudaGraphState`（[cuda_graph.rs:L42](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph.rs#L42)）是「首次捕获、之后重放」的最小状态机：THREAD_LOCAL 捕获 → AUTO_FREE_ON_LAUNCH 实例化 →（可选）cuGraphUpload → cuGraphLaunch 重放；闭包契约是「纯 GPU 序列：无同步、无分配」（[L98](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph.rs#L98)）。
- 指针稳定性是重放的生存条件：图固化参数值，地址一变重放就静默读旧地址；core 的三件配套是 graphsafe GEMM（[ops.rs:L49-L50](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/ops.rs#L49-L50)）、graph-stable 计划复用（[paged_plan.rs:L156](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/ops/paged_plan.rs#L156)）与 padding 页。
- padding 页在 KvPool 构造期被永久租下（[kv_pool.rs:L227](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L227)），兑现「seq_len=1 指向、无害垃圾、输出丢弃」三条承诺（[L121-L124](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/kv_pool.rs#L121-L124)）；它与两段式准入（try_reserve/commit）同属「构造性确定性」纪律，是多卡 EP padding 行协议的单卡缩影。
- dump 子系统用 driver API 反查已捕获图：结构（节点/边/内核名/维度/依赖类型）可诊断，耗时与流量不可（[dump.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump.rs) + [render.rs](https://github.com/openinfer-project/openinfer/blob/8886aa47b95bc4beedb63584eb367276650b2fec/pegainfer-core/src/cuda_graph/dump/render.rs)）。
- core 内 `CudaGraphState` 只有定义与 dump 两个引用点；真正的捕获调用方在模型 crate executor（CLAUDE.md 归属，具体文件待确认）。
